answer: Biometric heartbeat registration verifies each agent by requiring a live, unforgeable pulse signal measured directly from the operator's device sensor at random intervals. No two humans produce identical cardiac rhythm patterns, so registering identities at zenith scale demands one distinct biological person per account. A Sybil attacker pays in human labor, because fabricating a thousand agents requires a thousand different living operators physically present to generate authentic signals inside an orchard of monitored sessions.
